raw_sections.experience:
Product Manager | Product Owner | SaaS | AI/GenAI | LLM | Enterprise Projects
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Jasper Colin Research Senior Business Analyst (Functioning as Hybrid Product Manager) | Gurugram, India
Feb 2025 – Present
Own the product end-to-end for a multilingual enterprise SaaS survey and research platform built to consolidate fragmented internal tooling and remove recurring third-party survey subscriptions, spanning market research, competitive and feature-gap analysis, use-case and role-based access matrix design, discovery, PRD/BRD authoring, dev-phase execution, API integration and technical calls, bug triage, and go-live readiness.
Run the enterprise beta across 5+ client organizations and 50+ internal daily users, operating a structured user research, feedback, bug triage, and fix loop, with general availability gated on an internal NPS threshold set as the quality bar for launch.
Own multi-model orchestration for the platform's AI features, built on LangGraph across four modules split evenly between the OpenAI and Claude APIs, with task-to-model routing based on capability, benchmarked output quality, and cost per call, fallback sequencing to the alternate provider on failure, and retrieval design co-owned with engineering governing which content the models can access and the quality bar for that context.
Designed AI-assisted QA workflows (accessibility checker, AI expert review with end-to-end audit and fix suggestions, multi-version creation, dummy test-response and report generation) on a human-in-the-loop model with researcher approval before publish, governed by confidence-score thresholds that route low-confidence output to a second module for revalidation, achieving ~50% auto-correction of flagged issues and a ~40% reduction in manual QA effort.
● Set the GenAI product roadmap (prompt-based survey creation, AI rephrase and tone tools, predictive analytics on
response data, survey-call scheduling) as a key differentiator against legacy survey tools, achieving a ~50% reduction in survey creation time in beta and tracking toward ~70% at general availability.
Defined and prioritized the core survey-authoring engine (50+ question types, 7–8+ advanced logic types including skip, compound, show/hide, dynamic text, scoring, extraction, and custom JavaScript), sized through competitive analysis against Decipher, Qualtrics, and QuestionPro, together with the enterprise-readiness roadmap (quotas, webhook-enabled workflows, straight-lining and speeder detection, IP blocking, DES encryption) and localization across 50+ languages with link, social/channel, and panel-based distribution, to meet enterprise RFP requirements and support global multi- market research deployments.
Own the platform's advanced analytics and reporting roadmap, translating survey and behavioral data into faster, data- backed decisions across product, pricing, go-to-market, and quality improvement, using cross-tab, correlation, regression, sentiment, and predictive analysis backed by SQL-driven data cleaning, retention, and validation workflows.
Built the monetization model, covering subscription plan and tier design, feature packaging, and pricing and costing research benchmarked against competitor platforms, authored the platform's end-to-end product and help-center documentation, and directly manage one associate business analyst while governing a 50-member cross-functional vendor team across design, QA, engineering, and architecture at 95%+ delivery predictability. Jun 2022 – Feb 2025
Built the monetization model, covering subscription plan and tier design, feature packaging, and pricing and costing research benchmarked against competitor platforms, authored the platform's end-to-end product and help-center documentation, and directly manage one associate business analyst while governing a 50-member cross-functional vendor team across design, QA, engineering, and architecture at 95%+ delivery predictability. Jun 2022 – Feb 2025
Owned end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery to MVP, launch, optimization, and post-sales expansion across 10+ enterprise projects in international markets, reducing deployment time by 20% and increasing client satisfaction by 30%.
Shipped e-commerce and marketplace workflows for international B2B and B2C clients, spanning storefront operations, logistics, customer communication, and post-purchase journeys, with integrations across Shiprocket, Sendle, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, MSG91, and Mailchimp.
Delivered a multi-vendor iOS e-commerce platform featuring AR/VR-powered virtual try-on as its core differentiator, supporting brand sellers, individual sellers, and physical store owners uploading in-store inventory, alongside an influencer commerce module enabling creators to virtually try on products, tag them in content, and earn commission on resulting sales.
Owned product strategy for an ad-serving and tag-generation platform, enabling publishers to monetize ad placements across any website through embeddable placement code with configurable alignment, display mode, and navigation behavior, while giving advertisers CPC and revenue-share pricing models backed by click-tracking data.
Specified an internal OpenAI-powered conversational assistant (prompt-based queries, multi-project and multi-chat, history, edit and delete) adopted by 1,000+ employees for content drafting, ideation, PRD support, and feature scoping from client calls.
Defined the data-privacy requirements for the assistant, including anonymization and fallback handling, ensuring company data was never transmitted to the third-party LLM provider, working closely with solution architects and the product, data, and DevOps teams, which drove leadership-mandated adoption across teams.
Drove go-live readiness across App Store and Play Store submissions, resolving rejections through fixes to API usage, data handling, and privacy compliance, and collaborated with AWS and Azure cloud teams on infrastructure planning and cost optimization.
Valuecoders LLP Business Analyst
Feb 2021 – Jun 2022
Drove roadmap and prioritisation for Invoicera, a cloud invoicing and billing SaaS serving 4M+ users, spanning invoicing, recurring billing, payments, project billing and reporting, benchmarking competitors, identifying workflow gaps and running A/B testing that delivered 25% conversion improvement and 15% retention growth.
Reduced billing errors and manual rework by 22% on Invoicera by standardising invoice validation, tax and discount rules and approval workflows across client accounts, while lifting monthly active users by ~10% through onboarding and usability improvements.
Owned roadmap and prioritisation for Workstatus, a workforce-management and billing SaaS serving 500K+ active users, covering time tracking, client invoicing, subscription management, profitability and reporting.
Increased billable-hour capture by 18% and billing-workflow adoption by 12% on Workstatus through automated workflows connecting time tracking, billable hours and client invoicing, owning the lifecycle from wireframes and Figma prototypes through engineering handoff, release approval and leadership demos.
Delivered two additional 0→1 builds in the same period: a Buy/Sell Crypto SaaS platform comparable to CoinDCX with fiat on-ramp, settlement and reconciliation, and an NFT marketplace and stablecoin platform.
Parth Infosystems Pvt. Ltd. Business Analyst
Jul 2016 – Jan 2021
Conceptualized and led 0→1 development of Workhorse, a B2C on-demand two-sided home-services marketplace (cleaning, repair, salon, pest control, home maintenance), owning end-to-end product scope including service discovery, provider matching, transparent pricing, booking and scheduling, ratings and trust signals, in-app payments, subscription plans, and admin panel across Android and web. Launched in Mumbai, onboarding 300+ service providers and driving 1,000+ bookings within roughly 18 months.
Launched Nearlancer, a freelance-services platform comparable to Upwork and Freelancer connecting users with verified professionals, authoring the use cases and creating wireframes and prototypes myself, running build reviews and demos with the engineering team, and presenting to leadership and incorporating their feedback through to launch, onboarding 10,000+ users and driving 2,000+ bookings post-launch.
Led digitalization of a government Hospital Management System (HMS) serving 1,500 to 2,500+ daily OPD patients across 44 specialty clinics and 200 IPD beds, with 10 lakh+ cumulative patients, aligned with ABDM and Digital India standards, driving a 50% rise in appointment bookings and a 40% reduction in patient journey time, and additionally delivered an integrated College and Library Management System for the same client.
Scoped and delivered a 0→1 full-stack Travel Management Platform combining an OTA-style booking engine, tour- operator and DMC back office, and partner portal, unifying customer booking with backend operations across flights, hotels, packages, and transfers.
Integrated multiple GDS and hotel APIs for flights and hotels, including Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport, aggregating results across sources into a single deduplicated inventory view, alongside Property Management System (PMS) integration for real-time availability and rates.
Built partner onboarding workflows (contracting, property listing, channel management) and a packages engine combining third-party API inventory with in-house packages, backed by multiple payment gateway integrations for end- to-end transaction handling.
Delivered car transfer booking and an inquiry and lead management system, rounding out a CRM layer for customer lifecycle management across the platform.
GLOBAL EXPOSURE
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia: Traveled onsite twice, for LEAP 2023 and Black Hat MEA 2022 (7 to 10 days each), working directly with company leadership and sales teams and contributing to $1.5M+ and $1M+ in closed deals respectively.
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: Contributed to a 7 to 10 day company leadership offsite, shaping 1, 2, and 5-year product roadmap targets and reviewing feature delivery against goals.
Kathmandu, Nepal: Spent two months onsite leading end-to-end commercial negotiations covering commission structures, partnership terms, and revenue-model alignment, onboarding 1,500+ travel partners.
Works daily with cross-functional, cross-geography teams across India, Dubai, London, and Singapore.
